question: The amount on a sum of ₹4,800 at 15% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate of interest = 15% = 15/100 = 3/20

Multiplying factor for 1 year = 1 + 3/20 = 23/20

Multiplying factor for 2 years = (23/20) × (23/20) = 529/400

Amount after 2 years = 4800 × (529/400)

Amount = 12 × 529 = 6348

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6,348.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,800

Rate (R) = 15% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)T
